title: What is PTO-maxxing? How to turn 15 vacation days into 49 days off in 2026 and 2027
claim: National business press names and explains PTO-maxxing and already looks ahead to 2027; notes Christmas 2026 on a Friday and that about half of US workers with PTO use less than offered (Pew)
excerpt: Taking a Wednesday and a Thursday around Christmas (which lands on a Friday this year), means two PTO days turn into a five-day reset
